# Assert BEFORE copying. A hash checked after the fact is a log line, not a gate.
import hashlib, os, shutil
src_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/ep2-bark-plates-0815"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-bark-plates-0815"
WANT = {
  "b10-barkboard-pass-s13.png": "f5a5c1525f283e4c56ed3b9d46996e5cff1c333a3a9da09ecb244ac9e74d615b",
  "b06-barkboard-pass-s10.png": "063ad56112a718006b6eb2d883e3c01bcb579aef90ea0b201de27a29123565f9",
}
have = {}
for name, want in sorted(WANT.items()):
    p = os.path.join(src_dir, name)
    if not os.path.isfile(p):
        raise SystemExit("!! missing %s" % p)
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    got = h.hexdigest()
    if got != want:
        raise SystemExit("!! SHA MISMATCH, refusing to publish %s\n   want %s\n   have %s" % (name, want, got))
    have[name] = got
    print("asserted %s %s" % (got[:12], name), flush=True)
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
for name in sorted(have):
    shutil.copy2(os.path.join(src_dir, name), os.path.join(dst, name))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-bark-plates-0815.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join("%s  %s" % (have[n], n) for n in sorted(have)) + "\n")
print("published", len(have), "plate(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0)
